ho13.notes: Each cancellation with a last viewed title is matched to the subscriber's territory and to content_window rows with active_flag true. Expected 8,996 of 13,016 cancellations with a last title (69.1 percent). Accept 8,900 to 9,100. The 155 cancellations with no last title are left out. Checking windows in any country rather than the subscriber's own is a different test and is incorrect.
sql:
WITH ce AS (
  SELECT c.churn_event_id, c.subscriber_id, c.last_viewed_title_id, CAST(c.churn_timestamp AS DATE) AS churn_date, s.territory_id
  FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.churn_event c
  JOIN serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_subscriber.subscriber s ON s.subscriber_id = c.subscriber_id
), flags AS (
  SELECT ce.*,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window w
            WHERE w.title_id = ce.last_viewed_title_id AND w.territory_id = ce.territory_id AND w.active_flag = true) AS live_now,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window w
            WHERE w.title_id = ce.last_viewed_title_id AND w.territory_id = ce.territory_id
              AND w.window_open_date <= ce.churn_date AND (w.window_close_date IS NULL OR w.window_close_date >= ce.churn_date)) AS live_at_churn,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM serverless_lakebase_praneeth_catalog.hoshi_rights.content_window w
            WHERE w.title_id = ce.last_viewed_title_id AND w.territory_id = ce.territory_id) AS any_window
  FROM ce
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS churn_events,
  COUNT(DISTINCT subscriber_id) AS cancelled_subscribers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NULL THEN subscriber_id END) AS subs_null_last_title,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT live_now THEN subscriber_id END) AS subs_no_active_window_now,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT live_at_churn THEN subscriber_id END) AS subs_no_window_at_churn,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT any_window THEN subscriber_id END) AS subs_no_window_ever,
  SUM(CASE WHEN last_viewed_title_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT live_now THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS events_no_active_now,
